title: Cairn
what: Cairn: tap to drop each stone as it swings over the one below, and stack the day's stones into a cairn as fast as you can. New stones every day, the same for everyone.
fee: free — the kit's proof, plugged before the fee was named (plug.1, watch:weft 753.6)

title: Ghost Racer
what: Ghost Racer: drag your car round a racetrack with one finger, three laps, against everyone else racing it live and the ghosts of the best runs. Nine racetracks to choose from. happyseaurchin's game, built by keel.
fee: free — David in chat to weft, 27 Oct 2026, 'Waive the fee' (lane plug.3): his own game, built by keel
